title: Exponential Time Is Contained in Nondeterministic Exponential Time
statement: Every language in $\mathrm{EXP}$ belongs to $\mathrm{NEXP}$, where membership in $\mathrm{NEXP}$ means that there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V\in\mathsf{P}$ such that, for every binary string $x$, membership of $x$ is equivalent to the existence of a string $u$ of length exactly $C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ for which the concatenation $xu$ belongs to $V$.
replaced:
Every language in $\mathrm{EXP}$ lies in $\mathrm{NEXP}$: a language over the
binary alphabet decidable in time $2^{n^c}$ admits certificates of length
exactly $2^{(n+1)^c}$ together with a polynomial-time verifier language.
